playstyle.identity: Trundle is a stat-stealing troll who gets stronger by weakening enemies. His pillar creates terrain for zone control and his R steals tank stats.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive heals when enemies die nearby. Q empowers auto and steals AD. W creates a zone where you move faster and attack faster. E creates a pillar that slows and blocks. R steals enemy armor/MR, making tanks squishier and you tankier.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Trundle spikes at level 6 against tanks. Divine Sunderer scales him. He's strong at dueling tanks and disrupting with pillar.

passive.name: King's Tribute
passive.summary: Heal when enemy units die nearby.
passive.details: When any enemy unit dies nearby, Trundle heals for a percentage of their max health.

abilities.name: Chomp
abilities.summary: Empower next auto to deal bonus damage and steal AD.
abilities.details: Trundle bites a target, dealing bonus damage and stealing their attack damage for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Frozen Domain
abilities.summary: Create a zone that increases your attack speed, movement speed, and healing.
abilities.details: Trundle coats an area in ice, gaining bonus attack speed, movement speed, and increased healing while standing in it.

abilities.name: Pillar of Ice
abilities.summary: Create a pillar of ice that knocks aside and slows enemies.
abilities.details: Trundle creates a pillar of ice that acts as terrain, knocking enemies aside and slowing those around it.

abilities.name: Subjugate
abilities.summary: Steal armor and magic resist from an enemy.
abilities.details: Trundle drains a portion of an enemy's armor and magic resist, adding it to his own for several seconds.
